description: Where the ticket sales of ONE event come from (nev-data-api, analytics warehouse). Pick the event with nevent_list_events (TICKETED events), then choose a view. summary (default): sales grouped by dimension — provider, distribution channel, purchase channel, promo code or marketing (UTM source > medium > campaign; drill down with level + parent, copying the group key from the previous response); returns the top groups and an «Otros» bucket. daily: day-by-day series stacked by one dimension (provider | distribution | purchaseChannel | promoCode). campaigns: sales attributed to Nevent campaigns through tracking links. overview: totals, coverage and freshness of each block — read it first to know how much of the data carries provenance. from and to (YYYY-MM-DD, purchase days in tz, default Europe/Madrid) are required. Currencies are never added together: omit currency for one block per currency, or pass EUR. population defaults to SETTLED_SALES (settled sales); ALL_REPORTED includes refunded purchases and is NOT collected revenue. Amounts are the gross reported by the source, never net. Provenance fields can be missing: coverage and «unknown» buckets are part of the answer, do not present them as zero or as organic. The data is a warehouse (lags the sale by the pipeline); the view reports its freshness. Scoped to the active tenant and its descendants by the session JWT.

currency.description: ISO 4217 currency (EUR). NONE selects purchases without currency. Omit to get one block per currency: amounts of different currencies are never added together.

dimension.description: Grouping dimension. summary: provider | distribution | purchaseChannel | promoCode | marketing (default marketing). daily: provider | distribution | purchaseChannel | promoCode (default distribution; marketing is not allowed). Not valid for overview/campaigns.

event_id.description: Event ID (24-char hex). Get it from nevent_list_events.

from.description: First purchase day, YYYY-MM-DD (local day of tz). Required by every view.

level.description: summary with dimension=marketing only: source (default), medium or campaign. medium and campaign need parent.

parent.description: summary with dimension=marketing and level=medium|campaign: the key of the group one level up, copied verbatim from a previous summary response.

population.description: Which purchases to count. SETTLED_SALES (default): settled sales. REFUNDED_FULL: fully refunded. REFUNDED_UNREPRESENTABLE: other refunds (may be partial, refunded amount unknown). ALL_REPORTED: all of the above plus unrecognised states; its gross includes refunded purchases, so it is NOT collected revenue.

search.description: summary only: filter groups by text (max 100 chars).

to.description: Last purchase day, YYYY-MM-DD, inclusive. Max range 3660 days.

top.description: Groups to list before collapsing the rest into «Otros». summary: 1-50, default 20. daily: 1-10, default 4.

tz.description: IANA time zone that defines the purchase days. Default Europe/Madrid.

view.description: What to return. summary (default): sales grouped by provider / distribution / purchase channel / promo code / marketing (UTM). daily: dense day-by-day series stacked by one distribution dimension. campaigns: sales attributed to Nevent campaigns through tracking links. overview: totals, coverage and data freshness per block.

name: nevent_event_sales_provenance
